verdict.rationale: Lithic's official MCP server lets AI assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot execute live API requests from natural-language prompts. The agentic-payments blog shows card creation, Authorization Rule configuration and transaction runs driven this way, so the core of the story is delivered through first-party tooling. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface that does not depend on a third-party AI client, any independent or hands-on confirmation that natural-language operation works reliably, and documentation of which operations are covered and what guardrails apply.
